articles.title: Joby flies first point-to-point air taxi flight tests in New York
articles.mainIdea: Joby flies first point-to-point air taxi flight tests in New York
articles.summary: Reuters: Joby flies first point-to-point air taxi flight tests in New York. April 28 (Reuters) - Joby Aviation is conducting a week-long test of the first point-to-point air taxi demonstration flights in New York City as the ‌company gets closer to winning government approval to deploy commercial electric vertical takeoff ‌and landing aircraft. The tests this week of the aircraft known as eVTOLs are under a pilot program announced ​by the Federal Aviation Administration in September. Related tickers mentioned: JOBY.

articles.title: The DHS Shutdown Hits Day 73. Nightmare Airport Lines Could Return Soon.
articles.mainIdea: The DHS Shutdown Hits Day 73. Nightmare Airport Lines Could Return Soon.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: The DHS Shutdown Hits Day 73. Nightmare Airport Lines Could Return Soon.. Travelers could again face longer lines at airport security checkpoints next month if Congress doesn’t figure out a way to fund the Department of Homeland Security this week. The federal government is on track to run out of emergency funds used to pay some DHS workers during the past month of the department’s 73-day shutdown, including Transportation Security Administration employees that staff airport screening lines. President Donald Trump had allocated $10 billion in emergency funds for DHS employees in executive orders in March and April. Related tickers mentioned: UAL.
